tasks.title: Lecture #4
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a history class.
tasks.transcript: If you think about it, thanks to e-mail and computers we hardly write letters on paper anymore. Most people don’t even pay bills through the mail anymore, or mail informs to schools or to the government. It seems almost everything can be done online now. Keep in mind though that e-mail is a very recent development, but postal services systems for delivering physical paper letters and documents and other items, well, they have been around for a long time. For example, we know that in ancient times, documents were transported by riders on horseback. They usually used a relay system, which means that one mail carrier would travel a certain distance with the mail and then pass it on to someone else, whose job was to take it the next part of the way. In ancient China, for example, the government set up a large network of stations, where fresh horses were kept. So mail carriers could deliver official documents to far away parts of the kingdom more quickly. Now during the Roman Empire, almost two thousand years ago, Roman rulers established their own system of roads and stations for mail delivery across the Empire’s vast lands. Interestingly, even after the Roman Empire ended, its postal system remained intact; in other words, even though there was no official Roman Empire to govern the territories, the people living in the area found the postal system created by the Empire so useful that they continued to use it. Then about five hundred years ago, during the Renaissance in Europe, different countries began to travel farther and farther, when they started trading goods. This led to a need for commercial documents to be delivered quickly and safely. That’s when private business got involved and started their own postal systems. So now it wasn’t only government that were delivering mail, and that’s pretty much what it is like in the world today. Most governments operate their own postal services, but there are also many private companies that deliver letters and documents. Of course, with today’s technology, there may soon be no need for any of them.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The influence of the Roman Empire on businesses
options.C: Ways postal services have changed over time
options.D: Reasons that most people do not send paper documents

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这次谈话的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：...postal services systems for delivering physical paper letters and documents and other items, well, they have been around for a long time. For example, we know that in ancient times... during the Roman Empire... during the Renaissance... that's pretty much what it is like in the world today. 选项分析： A. 罗马帝国对商业的影响。谈话中提到了罗马帝国的邮政系统，但重点在于其作为邮政历史的一部分，而非讨论其对商业的影响，因此A选项错误。 B. 电子邮件服务的改进。谈话开头虽然提到了电子邮件，但只是为了引出话题，强调邮政服务有更长的历史，并非讨论其改进，因此B选项错误。 C. 邮政服务随时间变化的方式。谈话按照时间顺序，从古代的骑马信使、中国驿站、罗马帝国邮政，到文艺复兴时期私营邮政的出现，再到今天的状况，系统地讲述了邮政服务的发展和变迁，因此C选项正确。 D. 大多数人不寄送纸质文件的原因。谈话开头提到了这一点，但同样只是引子，并非全文主旨，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the teacher suggest about the early mail carriers who rode on horses?

options.A: They were highly respected by people at the time
options.B: They often took a piece of mail only part of the way
options.C: They usually traveled with soldiers for protections
options.D: They had to pass a physical test to get a job

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：关于早期骑马的邮件信使，老师暗示了什么？ 定位原文：They usually used a relay system, which means that one mail carrier would travel a certain distance with the mail and then pass it on to someone else, whose job was to take it the next part of the way. 选项分析： A. 他们在当时受到高度尊重。原文并未提及信使的社会地位，因此A选项错误。 B. 他们通常只将邮件运送一段路程。原文描述的接力系统（relay system）正是说一个信使走一段距离，然后把邮件传给下一个人，因此B选项正确。 C. 他们通常与士兵一起旅行以获得保护。原文完全没有提及士兵或保护措施，因此C选项错误。 D. 他们必须通过体能测试才能获得工作。原文并未提及任何选拔或测试过程，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What happened to the Roman mail system when the Roman Empire ended?

options.A: It was taken over by a private business
options.B: The Romans destroyed most of it
options.C: It continued to be used for a period of time

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：当罗马帝国结束时，罗马的邮政系统发生了什么？ 定位原文：Interestingly, even after the Roman Empire ended, its postal system remained intact; in other words, even though there was no official Roman Empire to govern the territories, the people living in the area found the postal system created by the Empire so useful that they continued to use it. 选项分析： A. 它被一家私营企业接管了。原文提到系统保持完整并被继续使用，但并未说明被私人接管，私营邮政是后来文艺复兴时期才出现的，因此A选项错误。 B. 罗马人摧毁了它的大部分。原文明确说系统保持完好（remained intact），因此B选项错误。 C. 它被继续使用了一段时间。这与原文中人们发现它很有用并继续使用的描述一致，因此C选项正确。 D. 各国争夺它的管理权。原文并未提及争夺或冲突，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What led to the establishment of private postal system during the Renaissance?

options.B: Growing numbers of people who could read and write

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：什么导致了文艺复兴时期私营邮政系统的建立？ 定位原文：Then about five hundred years ago, during the Renaissance in Europe, different countries began to travel farther and farther, when they started trading goods. This led to a need for commercial documents to be delivered quickly and safely. That's when private business got involved and started their own postal systems. 选项分析： A. 国际商业的增加。原文明确指出国家间开始贸易货物，导致了对商业文件快速安全递送的需求，从而催生了私营邮政，因此A选项正确。 B. 越来越多的能读会写的人。原文并未提及读写能力的普及，因此B选项错误。 C. 印刷技术的进步。原文并未提及印刷技术，因此C选项错误。 D. 土地所有权法律的变化。原文完全没有涉及土地法，因此D选项错误。
